## What does this change?

<!-- e.g. "Adds tool X", "Corrects the unit of metric Y", "New gap: …" -->

## Checklist

- [ ] One entity per note; file name = `title`
- [ ] Created from a template in `content/Templates/`, with a free `id` (`npm run validate` tells you the next one)
- [ ] New or changed claims are backed by `sources` (or honestly marked evidence C/D)
- [ ] Nothing copied from standards — scope paraphrased, catalogue page linked
- [ ] New notes have `status: proposed`
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes (it also runs automatically)
